intro: This page lists the best government MBA / PGDM colleges in Jharkhand by the average packages in our records. We currently link {{count}} programme options at only {{colleges}} public colleges: IIM Ranchi and IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.
That is a very short government list, now using recent official placement reports: IIM Ranchi's 2024-25 figures and IIT (ISM) Dhanbad's 2025-26 MBA averages.
listLead: IIM Ranchi appears first on its official 2024-25 MBA Business Analytics card, then IIT (ISM) Dhanbad on its official 2025-26 full-time MBA average.
snapshot: Only {{colleges}} colleges are on this page, so we have not quoted a package median in this text. Read each official placement report on its own.
In the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking, IIM Ranchi is 18 and IIT (ISM) Dhanbad is 48. Use those official ranks when you compare top MBA / PGDM colleges in Jharkhand 2026.
firstCollegesLead: Our cards now follow official reports: IIM Ranchi MBA BA 2024-25 average ₹19.86 LPA and highest ₹27.94 LPA, and IIT (ISM) Dhanbad MBA 2025-26 average ₹11.64 LPA (median ₹12.50 LPA; no course-wise highest was published).
Our fee file shows ₹8.75 lakh for an MBA in Business Analytics at IIM Ranchi and ₹1.73 lakh for an MBA Finance row at IIT (ISM). Check whether those are current full-programme fees.

sections.heading: Why the Jharkhand package years need care
paragraphs: The cards now use official 2024-25 and 2025-26 figures. Still confirm any later official report before you treat a package as current.
Both cards are now for full-time MBA programmes. IIM Ranchi still has no separate flagship MBA programme row in our file, so the official MBA BA (and MBA HR) figures are the ones stored.

compare.heading: How to compare the best government MBA / PGDM colleges in Jharkhand
paragraphs: With only two campuses here, the useful comparison is between IIM Ranchi and IIT (ISM) Dhanbad, using official reports rather than our older summary years.

faqs.question: Are the packages on this page current?
faqs.answer: The cards now use official 2024-25 and 2025-26 figures, but offers still change with every batch. Use each institute's latest official placement report before you compare averages.

faqs.question: What are the NIRF 2025 ranks for these two campuses?
faqs.answer: In the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking, IIM Ranchi is 18 and IIT (Indian School of Mines) Dhanbad is 48.

faqs.question: Why might IIT (ISM) show a high average?
faqs.answer: The IIT (ISM) card is now the official 2025-26 full-time MBA average of ₹11.64 LPA. The official course-wise table did not publish a highest CTC for MBA.
